mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate quetiapine's CNS depressant effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; quetiapine may cause orthostatic hypotension compounding loop diuretic effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes (K+, Na+) regularly, assess blood pressure and orthostatic changes, and consider potassium supplementation if needed during concurrent use.
